facts.rationale: The complete body contains exactly these assignments, while the canonical structure declares additional members not reset here.
facts.value: Performs Samus-specific death reset by calling ftParts_80074A4C(gobj, 0, 0) and assigning zero to x222C, x2230, x2238, x2244, x223C, and x2240. These are selected members of Samus's FighterVars block, not the complete block; the callback does not itself destroy articles.
